Description

Companion of Sahagin Tamer. Included in the master's encounter; no separate XP award.

Defense

AC 16, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+1 Dex, +6 natural, -1 size)

hp 30 [44] (4d8+12)

Fort +8; Ref +5; Will +2

SQ Link, Shared Rage
